name: carnufex
description: Christopher's Claude Code skills, shared across his repositories: issue-to-production delivery with review keys, review sweeps and pull-request hotspot reviews, PR demo videos, and GitOps app onboarding. Each skill keeps project facts in a profile file in the repository it runs in.

plugins.name: delivery
plugins.description: From issue to verified production: ready issues with a review key, race-safe claims, an implementer/reviewer loop that an independent key-reviewer agent must pass, milestone planning, needs-human decisions recorded as ADRs, and shipping through GitOps with a live check and rollback by revert.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Whole-codebase review sweeps that file one verified issue per finding, and pull-request reviews that point a person at the three places worth their ten minutes.

plugins.name: gitops
plugins.description: Onboard a new application into an ArgoCD ApplicationSet cluster, with every namespace whitelist, External Secrets, routes and the alert that tells on-call it is down.

plugins.name: showcase
plugins.description: Show a pull request instead of its code: a short rendered video of what changed, the animated flow, before/after, the recorded run and the review key's verdict, posted with the PR link to Slack.
